head: Leash Lookout maps your dog-walking route house by house
dek: Leash Lookout turns your daily dog walk into a map you keep, house by house, with the people you pass and the help you might need one tap away. It was #39 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 7 November.
details: It came out on 6 November and costs $1, by Pankaj Khemka.
means: If you walk the same route every day, it helps you remember the neighbours and dogs on it.
todo: Find Leash Lookout in the App Store.
